title: Fix test_syslog failure on backend testbeds
author: neethajohn

**Description**
--- snippet from mail thread discussions with Ying, Xin and Yuxuan
2. This test is done with image 20201231.34, with the syslog IPv6 fix. There are 2 issues with these test results:
a.	For IPv6 test, I checked the testbed, there is no default gateway for IPv6 due to the backend configuration. So all IPv6 rsyslog IO would be dropped. So the test will fail.
b.	For IPv4 test, the default gateway is pointing to the mgmt. port. And the IP addressed used for test is also pointing to the mgmt. port. As result, the rsyslog IO would have gone out from the mgmt. port. Why is the test still passing?

For issue 2, the test_rsyslog needs to be updated to check default route firstly. If default route does not exist or points to mgmt. port, the test can add a static route for syslog server and remove it after testing is done. @Yuxuan Ye Can you update the script to do so?
For issue 2.b, tcpdump is executed for all interfaces, including the mgmt. interface. That’s why it passed. @Yuxuan Ye Please update the script to firstly lookup routing table to find out the target interfaces. Then only run tcpdump on these interfaces. BTW, to increase robustness, can you also prepare a set of dummy syslog server IP addresses on different networks. Before testing, look up the routing table to select only the IP addresses that are not on directly connected subnet.

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run the syslog/test_syslog.py test on backend T1/T0 topology

**Describe the results you received:**
Test passed for ipv4 and failed for ipv6

**Describe the results you expected:**
Test should pass for both ipv4 and ipv6

linkedPullRequests.title: [syslog]Check DUT's default route before real tests start
linkedPullRequests.author: diaryevil
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: Yuxuan Ye <yuxuanye@microsoft.com>

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #4469

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [x] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Check default on DUT before real tests start.
  - If DUT has no IPv4 and IPv6 default route, skip syslog test.
  - If DUT has only IPv4/IPv6 default route, skip the test with any dummy syslog server IP matching the missed IP type 

And add some logs for debugging easier.

#### How did you do it?

- Add fixture `check_default_route` to get DUT's default route status and decide continue or skip. if continue, yield default route status to `test_syslog`. 
- Add `check_dummy_addr_and_default_route` to decide skip test with current parameter
- When test failed, dump DUT's default route and syslog config to logs

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run test_syslog with different DUT's default route: `IPv4+IPv6`, `IPv4`, `IPv6`, `None`.

#### Any platform specific information?

No
